description: The sum of the non-heave and overall three-point percentages is nonnegative.
explanation: Both columns are percentages on a 0-to-1 scale, so each is nonnegative for every player-season row; their sum therefore cannot be below zero. The prior ordering is not universal because excluding heaves can change both made-shot and attempt denominators in ways that do not force one percentage to be larger.

description: Effective and true shooting percentages have a nonnegative combined value.
explanation: Both are efficiency percentages and are nonnegative in this scoring-rate table, so their sum cannot be negative.

description: Shot-quality average and true shooting percentage have a nonnegative combined value.
explanation: ShotQualityAvg is an estimated make probability and TsPct is a shooting-efficiency percentage; both are nonnegative by definition.
